title: pivr180 image circle correction
description: Image circle correction values saved by editor. A device default applies to every capture; a capture override replaces the default per camera.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file conforms to.

scope.description: device_default applies to all captures; capture_override applies to a single capture.

cameras.description: Correction per camera. In a capture override, each present camera replaces the device default for that camera.

image_circle.description: Fisheye image circle in the full-resolution source image, with the origin at the top-left pixel.

center_x_px.description: Horizontal position of the circle center in pixels.

center_y_px.description: Vertical position of the circle center in pixels.

radius_px.description: Radius of the circle corresponding to a 180 degree field of view, in pixels.

rotation_deg.description: Rotation around the circle center in degrees, positive clockwise as displayed.
